correctness.rationale: A cyclic word with all five-bit windows gives an Euler tour of the directed overlap graph; the first bits of the consecutive edges recover the word. The unique 00000 edge fixes the rotation, so the edge search counts each labelled necklace once and uses no reversal or complement quotient. Each tour also gives a bijection of the two arrivals and two departures at each of the 16 vertices, and conversely a choice of these bijections giving a single 32-edge orbit is a tour. Thus both searches exhaust the intended class. In each linear cut, a partition ends in some nonempty palindromic suffix, so prefix optimum plus one minimized over suffix starts is exact. Center-ordered updates are valid because any palindrome in a partition of the prefix before the one currently being processed ends strictly before the current palindrome starts. Fresh bounded code independently compared both cycle searches and both palindrome calculations on all 65536 roots. It reproduced the seven rooted frequencies 384,3554,18266,29118,12138,2030,46 in order from 4 through 10, the 14 joint min–max cells summing to 2048, and both canonical minimum-nine strings, each with 29 cuts of length nine and 3 of length ten and exchanged by bit complement up to rotation. All joint cells have unequal minimum and maximum; the first table is the histogram of optimal partitions of individual cuts, not the histogram of minima over a cycle. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/d2257b3c-59e3-428d-9843-dc1da9c0d978/independent_recheck.py, with full.json and smoke.json in that directory. The original verify.py and its reported output were read, not executed. This is an exhaustive result for order five only.

evidence: Both statements count rotations separately but do not quotient cycles by complement or reversal. A circular palindrome partition has a block boundary at which to cut, and a linear partition gives a circular one on rejoining the ends. Hence the circular optimum is exactly the best linear-root optimum.
In the feedback encoding, incoming state as at suffix s is sent to s(a xor g(s)); this is exactly the choice of the two local arrival-to-departure matchings at vertex s.

value.rationale: An exhaustive finite benchmark of how palindromic length varies with the cut on de Bruijn cycles is mathematically meaningful in itself. Here the benchmark, cut sensitivity and sharp extremal necklaces are already supplied by the matched record. The residual multiplicity detail on two known necklaces is a small readout of their existing per-cut optimum calculation with no separate mathematical question or demonstrated need. Correct and reproducible does not make this a distinct valuable census.
